expectations.text: The report runs the analysis script and reports numeric metrics
expectations.evidence: No script run; no CV, no transition rate, no numeric metrics

expectations.text: The report identifies a healthy sentence length CV (above 45%)
expectations.evidence: Qualitatively notes good variety but gives no CV or variance measurement

expectations.text: The report detects the stylistic fragment
expectations.evidence: Identifies 'Not a dramatic one.' and 'The gamble pays off.' as short fragment-style sentences

expectations.text: The report identifies varied paragraph lengths
expectations.evidence: Correctly describes 7 paragraphs varying from 1 to 4 sentences, notes deliberate distribution

expectations.text: The overall assessment is positive — good rhythm, not flat
expectations.evidence: Summary: 'Strong, controlled rhythm... genuine and purposeful'

expectations.text: The report follows the prescribed format with all sections present
expectations.evidence: Custom structure; no Key Metrics table, no quantitative distribution, no numeric flags
